content.text: {"core": "Drive gathers scattered motion into a single vector and pushes toward a chosen end. In Discipline, it commands the solitary practice, forcing the tending into one line of advance. Too Much, the push overrides the practice's own pace — momentum drives past the point where the tending yields, and forward motion strips the ground it moves across.", "sheetLine": "The push has outrun the practice; forward motion now wears down what it drives across."}
